body: r25-plugins (2026-10-07): (1) password change-expired changes an expired password with only the old one; the session it returns still waits for the second factor (lead checked: startSession -> CreateSessionWithOptions), but someone holding only the old password can change it and end the owner's sessions. (2) passkey allow-list needs metadata; the plugin checks the attestation chain itself because go-webauthn skips none/self attestation. (3) a re-hash no longer moves updated_at. (4) History(n) creates auth_password_history only when on. Examples read PORT and REPORT_PORT/API_PORT/PORT_B/ISSUER_PORT (r24). oauth ErrProviderUnknown is a plain error (r24).
